title: 집에서 보내는 휴가
intro: 집에서 보내는 휴가는 '휴가 때 집에서 하는 일 묘사 → 휴가 하루 일과 → 기억에 남는 집 휴가 → 여행과 집 휴가의 장단점 비교'로 출제됩니다. 연차를 내고 혼자 사는 아파트에서 늦잠 자기, 넷플릭스 영화 몰아보기, 한강 조깅, 친구들과 집 근처 맛집 가기, 대전 본가 방문을 묶어서 하나의 이야기로 준비하세요. '평소 회의가 많아 바쁘니까 휴가 때는 쉬는 게 최고'라는 이유가 핵심입니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장(Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think.) → 언제·누구와 → 집에서 하는 일(늦잠, 영화 몰아보기, 조깅, 친구 초대) → 집에서 쉬는 이유·느낌 → 마무리 문장(Yeah, that's ~)
장면을 고정하세요: 연차, 혼자 사는 7층 아파트, 소파에서 넷플릭스, 발코니 화분, 한강 조깅, 친구들·Minji와 동네 맛집, 대전 본가 방문.
하루 일과 질문은 아침 → 점심 → 오후 → 저녁 → 밤 시간 순서로, In the morning / After lunch / In the evening 을 쓰세요.
장단점 비교(여행 vs 집 휴가)는 입장 → 각각의 장점·단점 하나씩 → 내 경험 예시 → 결론 순서로 말하면 IH 이상 구조가 됩니다.

expressions.en: Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think.
expressions.ko: 아, 집에서 보내는 휴가요? 생각해 볼게요.

expressions.en: I take a few days off and just stay home.
expressions.ko: 며칠 연차를 내고 그냥 집에 있어요.

expressions.en: I watch movies all day on the couch.
I don't have to check my work email.
I go jogging by the Han River.
I visit my family in Daejeon.
It's the only time I can really recharge.
expressions.ko: 제가 진짜 재충전할 수 있는 유일한 시간이에요.

expressions.en: I don't have to worry about packing or booking anything.
expressions.ko: 짐 싸거나 뭘 예약할 걱정을 안 해도 돼요.

expressions.en: Traveling can be pretty tiring and expensive.
expressions.ko: 여행은 꽤 피곤하고 돈이 많이 들 수 있어요.

expressions.en: I spent the whole day in my pajamas.

expressions.note: 관용 표현, 결론 직전에 쓰면 좋아요

expressions.en: Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
expressions.ko: 그래서 제가 집에서 휴가 보내는 걸 좋아해요.

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you spend your vacations at home. What do you usually do during a vacation at home, and why do you prefer staying home?
questions.ko: 설문에서 휴가를 집에서 보낸다고 하셨습니다. 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때 보통 무엇을 하고, 왜 집에 있는 것을 더 좋아하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제 휴가를 내는지 → 집에서 하는 일 3가지(늦잠, 영화, 조깅·친구) → 집이 좋은 이유 → 'Yeah, that's why ~' 마무리
'평소 회의가 많아서 정말 바쁘다'를 이유로 넣으면 자연스럽게 감정이 들어가요.
혼자 사는 아파트의 소파, 발코니 같은 장소 디테일을 하나씩 넣어 보세요.

answers.IM3: Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think. A few times a year, I take a few days off and just stay home. I live alone in a small apartment near my office. During my vacation, I sleep in until ten. Then I watch movies all day on the couch. I also go jogging by the Han River. My daily life is pretty busy because I have a lot of meetings. So I just want to rest. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
answers.IH: Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think. I work at an IT company, and my daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings. So a few times a year, I take a few days off and just stay home. I live alone in a one-bedroom apartment, so it's really quiet and comfortable. First, I sleep in as long as I want. Then I binge-watch movies on Netflix, usually comedies or action movies. In the evening, I go jogging by the Han River, which is only ten minutes away by bike. Sometimes I meet my friends at a restaurant in my neighborhood. I prefer staying home because I don't have to worry about packing or booking anything. It's the only time I can really recharge. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
answers.AL: Oh, my vacation at home? Let me think. Honestly, staying home is my favorite way to spend a vacation. I work at an IT company on the marketing team, and my daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings. By the time I get home, I'm totally drained. So a few times a year, I take a few days off and do absolutely nothing special. I live alone in a one-bedroom apartment near my office, so it's my own little space. On the first day, I turn off my alarm and sleep in until I naturally wake up, which almost never happens on weekdays. Then I make a big cup of coffee, sit on the couch, and binge-watch movies on Netflix. I love comedies and action movies, so I'll watch three or four in a row. In the evening, I go jogging by the Han River to get some fresh air. And if I miss my family, I hop on the KTX and visit them in Daejeon for a day or two. The reason I prefer staying home is simple. I don't have to plan anything, pack anything, or spend a lot of money. It's the only time I can really recharge. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical day when you are on vacation at home. What do you do from the morning until night, and who do you spend the time with?
questions.ko: 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때의 전형적인 하루에 대해 말해 주세요. 아침부터 밤까지 무엇을 하고, 누구와 시간을 보내나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 아침(늦잠, 브런치) → 오후(카페에서 책, 공원 산책) → 저녁(친구들과 맛집 또는 조깅) → 밤(영화) → 마무리 문장
혼자 사니까 '낮에는 혼자, 저녁에는 친구들'처럼 누구와 보내는지를 분명히 말하세요.
In the morning, After that, In the afternoon, In the evening, Before bed 로 시간 순서를 만들어요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about a typical day on my vacation. In the morning, I sleep in until ten. Then I make a simple brunch at home. In the afternoon, I go to a cafe near my apartment. I drink an iced americano and read a book. In the evening, I meet my friends for dinner. We usually go to a restaurant in my neighborhood. At night, I watch a movie on Netflix. Yeah, that's a typical vacation day for me.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about a typical day on my vacation at home. I live alone, so I spend most of the day by myself. In the morning, I sleep in until about ten. I don't set an alarm at all. Then I make a simple brunch, like toast and eggs, and water the plants on my balcony. In the afternoon, I walk to a cafe near my apartment. I order an iced americano and read a book for a couple of hours. After that, I take a walk in the small park in my neighborhood. In the evening, I usually meet my friends for dinner. We try a new restaurant and talk about everything. When I get home, I put on my pajamas and watch a movie on Netflix until late. Yeah, that's pretty much a typical vacation day for me.
answers.AL: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. A typical vacation day for me is super slow and relaxing, which is the total opposite of my workdays. Since I live alone, I spend most of the day by myself, and honestly, I kind of love that. In the morning, I don't set an alarm, so I usually sleep in until ten or even later. Then I make myself a lazy brunch, maybe toast, eggs, and a big cup of coffee, and I water the little plants on my balcony while I listen to some IU songs. Around two, I walk to my favorite cafe in the neighborhood. I grab an iced americano and get lost in a book for a couple of hours, without checking my work messages even once. After that, I take a walk in the small park near my place or go jogging by the Han River if the weather is nice. In the evening, I usually meet up with my friends, and sometimes Minji joins us if she's not too busy at work. We try a new restaurant and chat for hours. When I get home, I change into my pajamas, curl up on the couch, and watch a movie until I fall asleep. Yeah, that's what a perfect vacation day looks like for me.

questions.en: Tell me about a memorable vacation you spent at home. When was it, what did you do, and did anyone visit you? Why was it so memorable?
questions.ko: 집에서 보낸 기억에 남는 휴가에 대해 말해 주세요. 언제였고, 무엇을 했으며, 누가 찾아왔나요? 왜 그렇게 기억에 남나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제·왜 휴가를 냈는지 → 무엇을 했는지·누가 왔는지 → 특별했던 순간 → 느낌 + 마무리 문장
남동생 Junho가 대전에서 올라와 내 아파트에서 같이 지낸 이야기처럼 '혼자 사는 집에 누가 찾아온' 장면을 쓰면 기억에 남는 이유가 분명해요.
과거 시제(took, came, cooked, watched)를 끝까지 일관되게 쓰세요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about a memorable vacation at home. Last winter, I took five days off after a big project. I was really tired. My younger brother Junho came from Daejeon and stayed at my apartment. We cooked dinner together and watched movies every night. We also went jogging by the Han River. It was really fun because I usually live alone. Yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about a memorable vacation I spent at home. It was last winter. My team had just finished a really big marketing campaign, so I was totally exhausted. I took five days off and decided to just stay home. The surprise was that my younger brother Junho came up from Daejeon to visit me. He stayed at my apartment for three days. Since I live alone, it was a little crowded, but it was so much fun. We slept in, ordered fried chicken, and binge-watched action movies on Netflix. One evening, we went jogging by the Han River, and he was way faster than me. It was memorable because we hadn't spent that much time together since I moved to Seoul. Yeah, that's why it was my most memorable vacation at home.
answers.AL: Oh, a memorable vacation at home? Let me think. It has to be last winter. My team had just wrapped up a huge marketing campaign, and for about two months, I had been working late almost every night. By the end, I was completely burned out. So I took five days off, turned off my work notifications, and planned to do absolutely nothing. But on the second day, my younger brother Junho texted me out of the blue and said he was coming up from Daejeon. He ended up staying at my apartment for three days. My place is just a one-bedroom, so he slept on the couch, and we were bumping into each other all the time. But honestly, it was one of the best vacations I've ever had. We spent the whole day in our pajamas, ordered way too much fried chicken, and stayed up late watching action movies. One night, we went jogging by the Han River, and he kept teasing me for being slow. What made it so special was that we hadn't hung out like that since I moved out for work. It reminded me of when we lived together in our old apartment. There's no place like home, especially with family. Yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.

questions.en: Some people like to travel during their vacations, while others prefer to stay home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each? Which do you prefer and why?
questions.ko: 어떤 사람들은 휴가 때 여행을 좋아하고, 어떤 사람들은 집에 있는 것을 더 좋아합니다. 각각의 장점과 단점은 무엇인가요? 당신은 어느 쪽을 더 좋아하며, 그 이유는 무엇인가요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 여행의 장점·단점 → 집 휴가의 장점·단점 → 내 선택 + 경험 예시(오사카 여행 vs 집 휴가) → 결론 마무리 문장
On the other hand, The downside is, But at the end of the day 같은 연결어로 장단점을 깔끔하게 나누세요.
직장인 입장에서 '연차가 많지 않고 평소에 바빠서 집에서 쉬는 게 진짜 재충전'이라는 결론을 내면 페르소나와 맞아요.

answers.IM3: Oh, that's a good question. Let me think. Traveling is fun and exciting. You can see new places and try new food. But traveling can be pretty tiring and expensive. Staying home is cheap and relaxing. But sometimes it's a little boring. I like both, but I prefer staying home. My job is really busy, so I just want to rest on my vacation. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
answers.IH: Oh, that's a good question. Let me think. Both have pros and cons. First, traveling is exciting. You can see new places, try new food, and make great memories. For example, my trip to Osaka with my coworker Minji was amazing. The downside is that traveling can be pretty tiring and expensive. You have to book everything and pack, and sometimes you come back more tired than before. On the other hand, staying home is cheap and relaxing. I don't have to worry about packing or booking anything. But it can get a little boring if you stay inside too long. Personally, I prefer staying home. My daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings, so on vacation, I just want to sleep in and watch movies. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
answers.AL: Oh, that's a tough one. Let me think. I think both options have clear pros and cons. Traveling is exciting because you get to see new places, try new food, and make memories you'll never forget. Last summer, I went to Osaka with my coworker Minji, and I still talk about it all the time. But the downside is that traveling can be pretty tiring and expensive. You have to book flights, pack, and run around all day, and sometimes you come back to work more exhausted than before. On the other hand, staying home is cheap and super relaxing. You can sleep in, eat whatever you want, and you don't have to plan a thing. The only problem is that it can feel a little boring, and you might end up wasting the whole vacation on your phone. Personally, I prefer staying home, at least most of the time. As an office worker, I only get so many days off, and my daily life is pretty busy because I have a lot of meetings. So when I finally get a break, what I really need is rest, not another schedule. At the end of the day, there's no place like home. Yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.

pronunciation.tip: 두 번째 음절 '케이'에 강세. v는 윗니로 아랫입술을 살짝 물고 소리 내요.
끝의 -xed 는 '렉스트'처럼 [kst] 로 짧게 끝내요. '릴랙스드'가 아닙니다.
h는 소리 내지 않아요. '이그저스티드', x는 [gz] 소리예요.
두 번째 음절 '차-'에 강세. 끝 ge는 '지'를 약하게, '리차지'처럼 말해요.
